text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Fire Brigade AdJ Short title and (Amendment). Order 1988 and shall be deemed to have come into commenceforce on the 9th November 1987.

The Fire Brigade Act (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") Amendment of shall with effect from the commencement of this Order be cited as the the title of the "Fire Service Act" and wherever a reference is made in any written Act. law to the "Fire Brigade Act" it shall be construed as a reference to the "Fire Service Act".

The Act is amended by deleting the words specified in the First Column of the Schedule to this Order wherever the said words appear in the Act and substituting therefor the words specified in the Second Column opposite thereto -

SCHEDULE First Column Second Column Fire Brigade Fire Service Controller Director Deputy Controller Deputy Director Divisional Officer Superintendent Fire Brigade General Orders Fire Service General Orders Made this 2nd day of June 1988, at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
